purpose: Four-point initial support check of a tangential MLS-centre shift; no production adoption
input: Retained lian_collapse_geometry_r1_particles.csv: 5000 actual initial soil coordinates, matched to actual IDs by prior closed geometry audit
kernel_and_matrix: Reuse pure cubic/support definitions from upl_wall_geometry_r1.py: binary64 2-D Cubic W/Fac and original unscaled 3x3 a_corr2, volume dp^2 at J=1
selection: Only the four previously identified full-rank weak top-side wall IDs; no search or parameter fitting
original_evaluation: Actual per-MK x=0 or x=4 side-wall reflection. Original mirror and physical wall-to-soil near eligibility remain unchanged.
shift: Fit centre = original mirror + (0,-dp) in x,z. This is tangential to the existing side wall, with no added top plane, top wall, top normal or changed geometric reflection.
existing_creation_limit: JSphCpuSingle.cpp:264-290 currently creates FitShift only for mirrors outside real wall half-spaces. All four points are inside; their existing shift is zero. This test does not alter that rule.
existing_return_semantics: JSphCpu.cpp:1630-1634 shifts fit centre; 1710-1713 restore value at original mirror with q=-physical gradient. Both fitted-intercept and dynamic nearest-sample-anchor reconstruction are reported. Physical fitted gradients are unchanged by evaluation-point translation for these affine fields.
reproduction: Record maximum absolute original-mirror value error and each physical-gradient-component error; no new numerical or physical acceptance threshold
det_gate: Original abs(raw unscaled determinant)>=1e-3, unchanged. Inverses of original failed-gate matrices are evaluated only as an offline diagnostic, never as an admitted production fallback.
arithmetic_limits: Double-only offline kernel/constants, numpy matrix inverse and direct original-node search. Not the CPU/GPU float kernel arithmetic, sorted neighbour accumulation or 0-ULP equivalence.
scope_limits: Initial J=1 only; no current-stage state, wall stress/NoSlip/pressure/Ace parity, free-surface evolution, deformed support, nonlinear field accuracy, flux, force or physical admission is established.
protected: Existing input/source/audit records remain unchanged; metadata before/after, no SHA scans, no solver/build/Git
